summary: Search code with automatic current-source verification.

help:
Usage: st search [OPTIONS] [query]...

  Search code with automatic current-source verification.

  Start with plain st search and 1-4 identifier or filename terms. Use the
  returned source before another lookup. Narrow with --path or --file, and use
  --text for literal content.

  The default auto scope validates indexed candidates against current source
  and recovers stale or missing definitions. Use --scope checkout for an
  alternate or offline checkout. Follow verification warnings and narrow
  truncated results for more source.

Arguments:
  query...  Search query (symbol name, function, class, endpoint)

Options:
  -P, --project <str>             Project ID (overrides auto-detection for
                                  this search)
  -b, --budget <int>              Token budget for prompt context  [default:
                                  1200]
  -l, --limit <int>               Maximum primitive results  [default: 20]
  --offset <int>                  Primitive result offset for text, symbols,
                                  or file listings  [default: 0]
  --text                          Search literal text/content
  --symbols                       Use the symbol search primitive
  -j, --json                      Emit full JSON payload
  -f, --file <str>                List symbols in a specific file
  --path <str>                    Restrict search to a relative file/subtree
                                  prefix
  --hint / --no-hint              Show refinement hints when results are poor
                                  [default: hint]
  --scope <auto|project|checkout>
                                  auto: verify current source and recover
                                  definitions; project: hosted project source;
                                  checkout: local search for alternate or
                                  offline checkouts  [default: auto]
  --install-completion            Install completion for the current shell.
  --show-completion               Show completion for the current shell, to
                                  copy it or customize the installation.
  --help                          Show this message and exit.

usage.when: repo/code discovery; before adding any function/endpoint/command/component — search first and extend a close match instead of writing new
precautions: start with default search; it validates indexed candidates against current source and recovers local definitions
use 1-4 identifier or filename terms and consume the returned source; narrow with --path or --file, and use --text for literal content
if mode=text-fallback or empty, refine the query or use a primitive; --scope checkout is for alternate or offline roots
on a close match, extend/reuse it rather than adding a near-duplicate
